phases.objective: Bind repository reconciliation apply execution to the exact dry-run plan identity and hash before authority evaluation or any mutation dispatch.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A dry-run repository reconciliation plan with exact operation, plan, base, and branch identity
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Only an apply request carrying the same plan_id and plan_sha256 can pass plan-binding validation; missing, changed, or replayed identity fails before authorization or mutation dispatch.
steps: Build a deterministic dry-run plan from an exact operation id, base SHA, branch SHA, recipe, and reconciliation evidence.
Bind plan_id into the hashed plan payload and return the resulting plan_sha256.
Rebuild the plan for apply using the same operation identity and supplied plan binding.
Reject missing plan hash, wrong plan hash, changed operation identity, or changed plan identity before authority evaluation.
Preserve existing lease, step authorization, idempotency, no-force-push, and same-cycle readback controls after binding succeeds.
assertions: plan_id is included inside the hashed plan payload.
Apply requires an explicit 64-hex plan_sha256 and explicit plan_id.
A different operation id changes the rebuilt plan hash.
A different plan id changes the rebuilt plan hash.
Plan binding is evaluated before authorizePlan and executeStep can be reached.
No force push, migration apply, protected-branch write, provider mutation, deployment, or secret access is introduced by this change.

phases.objective: Expose the already governed apply executor through the Admin adapter only after exact-plan binding, per-step authority, and same-cycle provider readback are wired and tested.
